spec.description: One real week of New York taxi trips (September 2015) replayed to the New York clock every 5 seconds: animated H3 flows between neighbourhoods, pickups and dropoffs by hexagon, trip arcs and live counters.

options.content:
## New York City taxis, live
One real week of 2015 — 3.09 million trips — replayed to the New York clock: the same weekday and the same time of day as there right now. Refreshes every 5 seconds.

Pick a cab type above, or click a hexagon on the pickups or dropoffs map to follow only the trips that start or end there.

spec.rawSql:
-- The replay clock: the current time in New York, carried over to the week of
-- Monday 14 September 2015 with the same weekday and time of day. The data
-- holds New York wall-clock time, with no time zone.
WITH clock AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2015-09-14'
         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t
)
-- The same trips aggregated to large hexagons (H3 resolution 7, ~5 km²):
-- from which neighborhood to which, without street-level detail.
-- Cross-filtering: the cab type picker, and the hexagon clicked on the pickups
-- map ($from_zone) or the dropoffs map ($to_zone). Empty means everywhere.
SELECT pickup_h3_7 AS origin_h3,
       dropoff_h3_7 AS dest_h3,
       count(*)::BIGINT AS trips
FROM read_parquet('http://feeds/datasets/nyc-taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE (
    (pickup_time > t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t)
    -- Past midnight on Monday, the window carries on at the end of Sunday.
    OR (pickup_time > t + INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t + INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  )
  AND pickup_h3_7 <> dropoff_h3_7
  AND cab_type IN (${cab_type:sqlstring})
  AND ($from_zone = '' OR pickup_h3_9 = $from_zone)
  AND ($to_zone = '' OR dropoff_h3_9 = $to_zone)
  -- The fare range brushed on the tip chart ($fare_lo, $fare_hi). Empty means any fare.
  AND ($fare_lo = '' OR fare >= try_cast($fare_lo AS DOUBLE))
  AND ($fare_hi = '' OR fare < try_cast($fare_hi AS DOUBLE))
GROUP BY 1, 2

-- The replay clock: the current time in New York, carried over to the week of
-- Monday 14 September 2015 with the same weekday and time of day. The data
-- holds New York wall-clock time, with no time zone.
WITH clock AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2015-09-14'
         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t
)
-- One arc per trip in the last 10 minutes. pickup_lat/pickup_lon and
-- dropoff_lat/dropoff_lon are names the panel recognizes as origin and destination.
-- The fare is `amount`, not `total`: the panel reads a column named `total` as a
-- flow count and renames it.
-- Cross-filtering: the cab type picker, and the hexagon clicked on the pickups
-- map ($from_zone) or the dropoffs map ($to_zone). Empty means everywhere.
SELECT pickup_lat, pickup_lon, dropoff_lat, dropoff_lon,
       passengers,
       total AS amount
FROM read_parquet('http://feeds/datasets/nyc-taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE (
    (pickup_time > t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t)
    -- Past midnight on Monday, the window carries on at the end of Sunday.
    OR (pickup_time > t + INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t + INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  )
  AND cab_type IN (${cab_type:sqlstring})
  AND ($from_zone = '' OR pickup_h3_9 = $from_zone)
  AND ($to_zone = '' OR dropoff_h3_9 = $to_zone)
  -- The fare range brushed on the tip chart ($fare_lo, $fare_hi). Empty means any fare.
  AND ($fare_lo = '' OR fare >= try_cast($fare_lo AS DOUBLE))
  AND ($fare_hi = '' OR fare < try_cast($fare_hi AS DOUBLE))

spec.description: Each arc is a trip from the last 10 minutes, cyan where it starts and magenta where it ends. With the cursor over the map, only the arcs that start or end within 0.7 km remain. Underneath, in amber, the same trips aggregated neighborhood to neighborhood (H3 hexagons of ~5 km²); those lines do not react to the cursor. A fare range brushed on the tip chart keeps only the trips inside it.
spec.title: Trip by trip · hover over the map to see what leaves and arrives in each area

spec.rawSql:
-- The replay clock: the current time in New York, carried over to the week of
-- Monday 14 September 2015 with the same weekday and time of day. The data
-- holds New York wall-clock time, with no time zone.
WITH clock AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2015-09-14'
         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t
)
-- Trips per minute since midnight, returned as instants of today so that
-- Grafana's time axis puts them in place.
-- Cross-filtering: the cab type picker, and the hexagon clicked on the pickups
-- map ($from_zone) or the dropoffs map ($to_zone). Empty means everywhere.
SELECT (time_bucket(INTERVAL 1 MINUTE, pickup_time)
        + (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') - date_trunc('day', t)))
       AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS time,
       count(*)::BIGINT AS "Trips per minute"
FROM read_parquet('http://feeds/datasets/nyc-taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE pickup_time >= date_trunc('day', t) AND pickup_time <= t
  AND cab_type IN (${cab_type:sqlstring})
  AND ($from_zone = '' OR pickup_h3_9 = $from_zone)
  AND ($to_zone = '' OR dropoff_h3_9 = $to_zone)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

-- The replay clock: the current time in New York, carried over to the week of
-- Monday 14 September 2015 with the same weekday and time of day. The data
-- holds New York wall-clock time, with no time zone.
WITH clock AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2015-09-14'
         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t
)
-- Tip against fare for trips in the last 30 minutes. Only trips paid with a
-- tip: cash tips are not recorded.
-- Cross-filtering: the cab type picker, and the hexagon clicked on the pickups
-- map ($from_zone) or the dropoffs map ($to_zone). Empty means everywhere.
SELECT fare AS "Fare",
       tip AS "Tip"
FROM read_parquet('http://feeds/datasets/nyc-taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE (
    (pickup_time > t - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t)
    -- Past midnight on Monday, the window carries on at the end of Sunday.
    OR (pickup_time > t + INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t + INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  )
  AND fare BETWEEN 2.5 AND 70 AND tip > 0 AND tip < 15
  AND cab_type IN (${cab_type:sqlstring})
  AND ($from_zone = '' OR pickup_h3_9 = $from_zone)
  AND ($to_zone = '' OR dropoff_h3_9 = $to_zone)

spec.description: Each dot is a trip paid with a tip in the last half hour. Drag across the chart to pick a fare range: the trip-by-trip arcs and the flows keep only the trips inside it. The eraser in the corner clears it.
spec.title: Tip against fare · last 30 minutes

options.content: **How it's built.** A Parquet file built once on this instance (`datasets/nyc-taxi/build.sh`), read by the DuckDB data source and four kepler.gl panels; the flows come straight from columns named `origin_h3`, `dest_h3` and `trips`, and the arcs from `pickup_lat`/`pickup_lon` and `dropoff_lat`/`dropoff_lon`. **Data:** NYC Taxi & Limousine Commission, yellow and green cabs, 14–20 Sep 2015, extracted from [QuestDB's public demo](https://demo.questdb.io). Inspired by their [taxi dashboard](https://questdb.com/dashboards/taxi/).

    -- Past midnight on Monday, the window carries on at the end of Sunday.
    OR (pickup_time > t + INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t + INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  )
  AND pickup_h3_8 <> dropoff_h3_8
  AND cab_type IN (${cab_type:sqlstring})

spec.description: Each animated line joins two H3 hexagons with trips between them; its width and color say how many. The circle at each hexagon splits into what leaves and what arrives. Everything is computed in DuckDB over a Parquet file on every refresh. A fare range brushed on the tip chart keeps only the trips inside it.
spec.title: Flows · trips that started in the last 10 minutes

spec.rawSql:
-- The replay clock: the current time in New York, carried over to the week of
-- Monday 14 September 2015 with the same weekday and time of day. The data
-- holds New York wall-clock time, with no time zone.
WITH clock AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2015-09-14'
         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t
)
-- In transit: picked up in the last 3 hours and not dropped off yet. The two
-- halves of the week wrap sit inside one pair of parentheses, so the filters
-- below apply to both.
-- Cross-filtering: the cab type picker, and the hexagon clicked on the pickups
-- map ($from_zone) or the dropoffs map ($to_zone). Empty means everywhere.
SELECT count(*)::BIGINT AS taxis,
       sum(passengers)::BIGINT AS passengers
FROM read_parquet('http://feeds/datasets/nyc-taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE (
    (pickup_time > t - INTERVAL 3 HOUR AND pickup_time <= t AND dropoff_time > t)
    OR (pickup_time > t + INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 3 HOUR AND pickup_time <= t + INTERVAL 7 DAY
        AND dropoff_time > t + INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  )
  AND cab_type IN (${cab_type:sqlstring})
  AND ($from_zone = '' OR pickup_h3_9 = $from_zone)
  AND ($to_zone = '' OR dropoff_h3_9 = $to_zone)

spec.rawSql:
-- The replay clock: the current time in New York, carried over to the week of
-- Monday 14 September 2015 with the same weekday and time of day. The data
-- holds New York wall-clock time, with no time zone.
WITH clock AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2015-09-14'
         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t
)
-- Pickups in the last 10 minutes per H3 hexagon at resolution 9 (~0.1 km²).
-- Filtered by the dropoff hexagon but never by its own ($from_zone): the map
-- you click on keeps showing every hexagon, so another one can be picked.
SELECT pickup_h3_9 AS h3,
       count(*)::BIGINT AS pickups
FROM read_parquet('http://feeds/datasets/nyc-taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE (
    (pickup_time > t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t)
    -- Past midnight on Monday, the window carries on at the end of Sunday.
    OR (pickup_time > t + INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND pickup_time <= t + INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  )
  AND cab_type IN (${cab_type:sqlstring})
  AND ($to_zone = '' OR dropoff_h3_9 = $to_zone)
GROUP BY 1

-- The replay clock: the current time in New York, carried over to the week of

  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2015-09-14'
         + ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
            - date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')) AS t

-- Dropoffs in the last 10 minutes per H3 hexagon at resolution 9. Filtered by

       count(*)::BIGINT AS dropoffs
FROM read_parquet('http://feeds/datasets/nyc-taxi/trips-2015-w38.parquet'), clock
WHERE (
    (dropoff_time > t - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND dropoff_time <= t)
    -- Past midnight on Monday, the window carries on at the end of Sunday.
    OR (dropoff_time > t + INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND dropoff_time <= t + INTERVAL 7 DAY)
  )
  AND cab_type IN (${cab_type:sqlstring})
  AND ($from_zone = '' OR pickup_h3_9 = $from_zone)
GROUP BY 1
